title: Containing the Dribbler Funnel
description: A defender funnels a ball handler toward the sideline rather than letting them attack the middle, using chair position rather than reaching to control the angle.

content.objective: Use chair position to keep the ball handler out of the middle of the floor.
content.setup: A ball handler faces a defender near the top of the key, free to attack either direction.
instructions: The defender angles the chair slightly to protect the middle, inviting the sideline.
The ball handler attacks at game speed in either direction.
The defender pushes to stay in front, always protecting the middle of the floor.
Rotate ball handlers every six reps.
coachingPoints: Angle the chair, don't just square up straight on.
Push to stay in front rather than reaching to slow the ball down.
Communicate 'I've got ball' to teammates throughout.
commonMistakes: Squaring up straight on instead of angling to funnel.
Reaching in instead of using chair position to stay in front.
Watching the ball only and losing track of the opponent.
content.safety: The ball handler should not initiate contact to create space.
